workload.description: The improved import at the size of the largest customer file seen so far, 200,000 records.

language_or_algorithm.statement: What is left is the language: one pass over the records, building each fingerprint a character at a time in the interpreter. No better algorithm is known; the work is already one pass.

decision.reason: The largest file seen takes under a second after the fix, and an upload is answered in the background: nobody waits for it. At best a port would save most of that second per upload, before the cost of converting the 200,000 records the function takes in. That is not worth a boundary between two languages. To be looked at again if files grow tenfold.
